title: Pullback into prior demand
thesis_summary: Synthetic M15 long in stalking. A displacement leg left a demand pocket, and price has returned to it without a confirmed reclaim. Waiting is the state, not a fill.

evidence.label: Pocket failure
evidence.detail: A body close through the demand pocket invalidates the long.
